blocks.text: Yeh bohat nasha-awar opioid drug hai jo afeem ke poday (opium poppy) se hasil hoti hai. Ise injection, dhuein (smoking) ya naak se soongh kar liya jata hai. Yeh jhoota sarsoor (euphoria, yaani shadeed josh aur khushi) aur sukoon deti hai. Is ka istemal jaldi dependence aur lat tak le jata hai. Is ke kai jismani aur zehni nuqsanat hain, jaise saans ka dab jana (respiratory depression), infections aur zehni bimariyan.
